question: Which of the following is a popular cloud storage service on the internet?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Google Drive**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Google Drive** is a widely-used cloud storage service provided by Google.
 
• It allows users to store files on their servers, synchronize files across devices, and share files with others.
 
• Google Drive offers 15 GB of free storage space, with options to purchase additional storage.
